messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Yuki runs the monthly cost review. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-13]
- Priya runs the quarterly capacity review. [valid 2025-06-23 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-23]
- Oskar runs the weekly architecture review. [valid 2026-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-16]
- Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day. [decision; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09-2]
- Team Atlas runs its planning meeting on Tuesdays. [valid 2025-10-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-31]
- Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The INC-2026-009 review found that the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice because two leaders were elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-10]
- On the 2026-02-12 rotation day, the Ember team on-call swapped and Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
    earlier: As of the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Diego is on call for the Ember team, having received the pager from Oskar. [valid 2025-12-29 to 2026-02-12; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- The billing service depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- The webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04-2]
- On 2025-07-10, the Team Cinder on-call swapped and Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team observed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
